sampling_matrix.why: magnetic closure boxes need enough internal tolerance for the product, insert and opening movement
sampling_matrix.buyer_input: product length, width, height, weight, item count, fragile parts and gift-set layout

sampling_matrix.why: magnet placement, flap depth and opening style affect unboxing feel and stability
sampling_matrix.buyer_input: reference opening style, magnet direction, lid overlap preference and whether a ribbon pull is needed

sampling_matrix.why: premium sets often fail at the insert stage if product movement is not reviewed early
sampling_matrix.buyer_input: paperboard, EVA, foam, molded pulp or tray direction, product arrangement and color direction

sampling_matrix.why: rigid box feel depends on board direction, wrap paper and edge finishing
sampling_matrix.buyer_input: greyboard direction, surface paper reference, color target, texture preference and edge-wrap expectation

sampling_matrix.why: foil, embossing, debossing, spot UV and soft-touch finishes need artwork and sample review
sampling_matrix.buyer_input: logo files, artwork status, Pantone or color direction, print coverage and finish reference photos

sampling_matrix.why: collapsible and assembled rigid boxes affect freight volume, storage and retail preparation differently
sampling_matrix.buyer_input: flat-pack or assembled preference, carton packing, target market, sales channel and document review requests
